additive_aggregate_equations: work_totals[path] = supervisor.work[path] + sum(attempt.work[path]) for every fully-qualified group.counter path
io call and byte totals = supervisor.io + sum(attempt.io)
cpu_user_ns and cpu_system_ns totals = supervisor values + sum(attempt values)
logical artifact and temporary-created byte totals are sums
charged totals use charged fields only; observed totals use observed fields only
accounting_closure.charged_success_rule: Every charged field equals its exact observed counterpart on success.
accounting_closure.conservation_scope: Optimizer conservation equations apply to observed counters of successful optimizer and verifier-replay receipts. Charged ceilings are conservative billing and do not satisfy algorithmic conservation equations.
accounting_closure.counter_path_rule: Counters are never flattened by leaf name. optimizer.retained_model_calls and verifier.retained_model_calls are distinct fully-qualified paths.

development_budget_distinction.rule: maximum_runs counts registered experiment runs only. Source implementation consumes neither experiment runs nor development children.

accounting_closure.maximum_concurrency_equation: Sort child intervals by (time,start-before-end,pid); sweep +1 at start and -1 at end; maximum_concurrency is the maximum live count.
peak_aggregate_equations: kernel_peak_rss_bytes = max(supervisor and child kernel peaks)
sampled_peak_rss_bytes = max(supervisor and child sampled peaks)
peak_live_temporary_allocated_bytes = max sampled campaign live allocated storage

binding_closure.rule: A missing binding key or unequal digest is INVALID before semantic work.

canonical_union.cell_universe: Cartesian product of 3 curve seeds, 3 factor-base seeds, 4 charts, 32 compilers, and 4 caps, in lexicographic tuple order; exactly 4608 identities.

rules: derivation_streams contains 3 accepted curve streams followed by 9 accepted factor streams
fixtures contains exactly 36 unique curve/factor/chart records
cells contains exactly the full 4608-cell universe
every cell status=complete and contains verification
decision classification is one complete-matrix terminal
derivation_streams contains every started curve/factor stream, tagged accepted or exhausted
fixtures contains only completely derived fixtures
completed_cells and missing_cells have unique sorted IDs
completed and missing IDs are disjoint and their union is the full 4608-cell universe
decision classification is INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE

control_closure.rule: controls must equal this complete ordered ID list; empty, duplicate, missing, or extra results are INVALID

exhausted_stream_rules: attempts contains exactly attempt_cap semantic rejected attempts numbered 0..attempt_cap-1
the final attempt retains its actual derivation rejection reason
ATTEMPT_CAP_EXHAUSTED appears only in terminal_reason and never in an attempt
accepted_stream_rules: for kind=curve, seed is one integer and accepted_value uses accepted_curve_value_exact_keys
for kind=factor_base, seed is exact object {curve_seed,factor_base_seed} and accepted_value uses accepted_factor_value_exact_keys
accepted_value is the exact curve_record or factor_base_record

development_closure.attempt_id_rule: The exact full IDs D01-PRODUCER-HAPPY through D13-RSS-LIMIT from source-schema-v3 are used; abbreviations D01..D13 are forbidden in artifacts.
development_closure.current_execution: Source implementation is allowed only after GO and consumes zero child budget. The 13 children remain unauthorized pending post-implementation review.
development_closure.mutation_order: M01 through M52, using exact IDs from the three mutation manifests/amendments

source_schema_v4.normative_precedence: V4 incorporates source-schema-v3 by exact hash and supersedes every conflicting or less-specific V3 statement.

verifier_independence.rule: Verifier uses a separately implemented standard-library-only transitive closure. Source text, AST imports, dynamic loaders, sys.modules, and resolved loaded-module paths are audited. Any forbidden reference is INVALID.
